amends.rule: observation records, compiler, labels, bounds, confidence, canonicalisation, and typed failures remain unchanged unless overridden here

credential_language_rule: only support-complete types independently eligible in both strata may enter L_cred-v3.1.0; exploratory 30/30 types are not gate-evaluable

pipelines.scientific_role: compositional baseline: open-set entity localization followed by experimental closed-label crop, ordered-pair-crop, and global scoring
pipelines.hypothesis_boundary: SigLIP2 pair-crop action/interaction classification is an experimental compositional hypothesis, not an established relation detector; failure is valid

adapter.detection_query: shared_gate_entity_label_intersection joined by period-space in config order
adapter.entity_threshold: one global detector threshold fitted on development only, then frozen
adapter.single_crop: tight detection box plus 10 percent width/height padding, clipped
adapter.pair_crop: ordered union crop plus 10 percent padding, two-pixel red source border and two-pixel blue target border
adapter.binary_template: a photo of the red-box {source_category} {binary_interaction} the blue-box {target_category}
adapter.score_rule: complete closed label set per task; one threshold and minimum top-two margin fitted on development only

components.checkpoint_identity: Hugging Face repository snapshot at exact revision
Hugging Face repository snapshot at exact revision
components.output: closed-label similarity scores for crop attributes/actions, ordered pair-crop interactions, and global scene

pipelines.acquisition_hash_rule: before extraction or inference, record each downloaded file name, byte count, source URL/etag if present, and SHA-256; any later mismatch fails closed

label_intersection.attributes_actions_interactions_scenes: exact L_visual-v3.1.0 labels scored as complete closed task sets

pipelines.failure_behavior: missing/incompatible licence, revision, hash, required component, unsupported label, OOM, or malformed bounded observation becomes a typed pipeline failure; no candidate substitution or output repair

pipelines.scientific_role: graph-native comparator: EGTR(VG) object/relation tensors plus independent SigLIP2 attributes and scenes

adapter.input: local RGB image under the official EGTR evaluation transform; no Visual Genome evaluation image is a project datum
adapter.entity_rule: softmax object logits; retain exact shared entity-label intersection above one global development-fitted threshold; convert normalized cxcywh to clipped xyxy
adapter.relation_rule: for retained ordered object-query pairs, multiply or jointly threshold component-local relation and connectivity scores using one predicate threshold and one connectivity threshold fitted on development only
adapter.label_normalisation: lowercase and replace spaces/hyphens with underscores; exact intersection only; no aliases or semantic nearest-neighbour mapping

excluded_project_predicate.touching: not in the frozen exact VG50 intersection

adapter.inverse_rule: unchanged compiler inverse-normalisation after exact intersection
adapter.siglip_single_crop: tight EGTR entity box plus 10 percent padding, clipped
adapter.siglip_score_rule: complete closed label set per task; one threshold and top-two margin fitted on development only
adapter.serialization_boundary: adapter emits bounded observation records only; deterministic compiler exclusively owns IDs, counts, geometry, graph invariants, and credential serialization

components.checkpoint_identity: egtr_vg.tar.gz from official Google Drive file 18phcRxbrEI7HqIuM2OLAPuwAF5k3pUC2
components.license: Apache-2.0 official repository; checkpoint provenance and absence of incompatible separate terms must be recorded before acquisition
components.vocabulary: Visual Genome 150 object classes and 50 predicate classes from checkpoint artifact metadata
components.output: object logits, normalized boxes, relation logits, and connectivity scores

components.checkpoint_identity: Hugging Face repository snapshot at exact revision
components.output: closed-label crop attributes and global scene scores

pipelines.acquisition_hash_rule: before extraction or inference, record archive/file names, byte counts, source URLs/etags, and SHA-256; preserve the archive hash and extracted manifest; mismatch, missing config labels, or incompatible terms fails closed and requires a new preregistration before inference
pipelines.threshold_fit: entity, predicate, connectivity, SigLIP task, and top-two-margin thresholds use development only and freeze before validation
pipelines.failure_behavior: licence/provenance ambiguity, unavailable official checkpoint, artifact/config mismatch, unsupported exact label, required-component failure, OOM, or malformed bounded observation is a typed pipeline failure; do not restore SGTR or add another candidate

rejected_graph_candidates.reason: superseded before output by EGTR due older/thinner artifact, legacy multi-GPU path, and licence presentation conflict; retained in immutable v3.0.0
autoregressive scene-graph text/JSON and semantic label mapping reintroduce structured-generation risk; multi-component artifact and release metadata are not preferable to bounded EGTR tensors
